title: SON CUBANO: Timing, Basic Steps and Sequences

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses a casual, humorous teaching approach with multiple students in the studio. He breaks down timing and posture through repetition and physical demonstration.

lesson_structure.note: Warming up with basic body movement and rhythm
Breaking down the basic step and posture
Discussing tumbadora timing and attitude in movement
Partnering and posture exercises in close connection

metaphors: Like you've got something bouncing on your head
common_mistakes: Slacking in the upper body and head bounce

steps_taught.name: Basic Son Step
steps_taught.description: Stepping forward and back with knee articulation and upper body attitude

what_works: Multiple dancers in the room showing different angles
what_hinders: Spoken instructions are sometimes muffled or casual

quotes.text: You can go too if you want.
The most important thing about Son, other than finding the bump and tempo... is the attitude.
How close can you rest? Can we make like this kind of contact?

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor and student standing facing the mirror practicing rhythm
Instructor demonstrating knee bounce and step timing in place

extraction.distinctive_method: Integrating multiple students with varied styling to demonstrate how posture and attitude translate to solo versus partner dancing.
